import numpy as np

# Calculate correlation between education expenditure and school enrollment
education_expenditure = adjusted_savings.iloc[:, 2:].values
school_enrollment_primary = school_primary.iloc[:, 2:].values
school_enrollment_secondary = school_secondary.iloc[:, 2:].values

correlation_primary = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, school_enrollment_primary)
correlation_secondary = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, school_enrollment_secondary)

correlation_primary, correlation_secondary

# Calculate correlation between education expenditure and economic output
gni_per_capita_values = gni_per_capita.iloc[:, 2:].values
exports_values = exports.iloc[:, 2:].values

correlation_gni = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, gni_per_capita_values)
correlation_exports = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, exports_values)

correlation_gni, correlation_exports

from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer

# Load the datasets
adjusted_savings = pd.read_csv('/data/Adjusted_savings_education_expenditure_percentage_of_GNI.csv')
exports = pd.read_csv('/data/Exports_of_goods_and_services_annual_percentage_growth.csv')

years = [col for col in adjusted_savings.columns if col.startswith('YR')]
